text: MODIS records locate the center of a 1 km hotspot pixel, not necessarily an individual fire. One pixel can contain multiple fires. Satellite hotspot detections are not a count of distinct fires.
VIIRS 375 m data complements MODIS detections. Its improved resolution responds better to relatively small fires and maps large fire perimeters in more detail, so MODIS and VIIRS counts can differ.
FIRMS replaces near real time NRT archive records with standard MODIS and VIIRS products as they become available, usually after two to three months but possibly up to five months.

The supplied project plan limits this analysis to 37–42 N and 125–119 W, complete weeks in 2023–2025, training in 2023–2024 and testing in 2025. A zero means zero supplied archive records, not absence of fire or confirmed observing coverage.
